verse: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
story: Joshua is about to lead a nation, and God's first counsel is not about strategy.
Keep this Book of the Law on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may do all that is written in it. The way to a life that holds is not more willpower but a mind soaked in God's word.
Give it a place in your day. What you meditate on is what you become.
